column.name: delai_max_jours
column.remarks: Délai maximal (D-106) ; NULL = égal au délai cible (delai_jours).

changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE reference_operation ADD CONSTRAINT ck_reference_operation_delai_max CHECK (delai_max_jours IS NULL OR (delai_max_jours BETWEEN 0 AND 365 AND delai_max_jours >= COALESCE(delai_jours, 3)));

column.name: echeance_cible
column.remarks: Échéance cible planifiée (D-106) ; echeance est l'échéance maximale.

changeSet.sql: UPDATE parcours_operation SET echeance_cible = echeance WHERE echeance_cible IS NULL AND echeance IS NOT NULL;
